objective.text: Detect accidental lazy loading with a regression setup that actually exercises hydrated models.

difficulty.rationale: Exercise the actual guarded hydration path and trigger a relationship read.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A test wants to catch an N+1 caused by reading articles without eager loading. In Laravel 13.40, which setup reliably exercises the normal prevention flag on a retrieved collection?

options.text: Enable preventLazyLoading and read articles after with("articles")->get().
options.rationale: The relation is already loaded, so this does not exercise the lazy-load failure case.
options.misconception: The relation is already loaded, so this does not exercise the lazy-load failure case.

options.text: Enable preventLazyLoading, retrieve at least two writers without articles, then access one writer’s articles.
options.rationale: The multi-model hydration path propagates the prevention flag; accessing an unloaded relation then exposes the violation.

options.text: Enable preventLazyLoading and instantiate new Writer() without any relationship access.
options.rationale: No retrieved collection or lazy relationship read occurs, so the test cannot expose the N+1.
options.misconception: No retrieved collection or lazy relationship read occurs, so the test cannot expose the N+1.

options.text: Enable preventLazyLoading and only call Writer::count().
options.rationale: An aggregate count does not hydrate a model or attempt a lazy relationship access.
options.misconception: An aggregate count does not hydrate a model or attempt a lazy relationship access.
